factsheets.title: Public factsheets
factsheets.body: In English, Arabic, Bulgarian, Latvian, Polish, Punjabi, Romanian and Urdu, so language is never a barrier to understanding what domestic abuse is and where to get help.

factsheets.title: Professional factsheets
factsheets.body: Guidance for employees and employers, frontline professionals and other services who may meet someone experiencing abuse.

factsheets.title: For children and young people
factsheets.body: Age-appropriate materials to help children and young people understand abuse and know how to get help.

factsheets.title: For adults
factsheets.body: Guidance and self-help materials for adults affected by domestic abuse, whether in crisis now or further along in recovery.
